Description: A unique identifier assigned to each applicant who has submitted their information for a job opportunity
The date on which the applicant submitted their application for the job
The first name of the applicant
The last name of the applicant
The contact phone number of the applicant
The email address of the applicant for communication purposes
The street address where the applicant resides
The city where the applicant's address is located
The state or province where the applicant's address is situated
The postal or ZIP code associated with the applicant's address
The country where the applicant's address is located
The highest level of education attained by the applicant
The number of years of professional experience the applicant has
The salary the applicant wishes to receive for the job
The title or designation of the job the applicant is applying for
The status of the applicant's application
